title: Subword Tokenization for On-Device NLP: How BPE Works
meta_title: Subword Tokenization for On-Device NLP: How BPE Works
meta_description: How byte pair encoding (BPE) builds compact subword vocabularies, why it beats word- and character-level tokenizers, and what it means for on-device NLP.
author: ReLU.chat
excerpt: Byte Pair Encoding builds a compact subword vocabulary by merging the most frequent character pairs, and it is why small on-device models can handle full natural language without giant embedding tables.
